notes:
**Status: pending approval by Christian.** CHR-925 / CHR-906. Opened from "Connect AI tools…" in the settings menu.

**Dialog.** Modal over `chrome-scrim`, 560px wide, padding 24 ($spacing.3xl), radius.md 10, gap 12, `chrome-shadow-float`. Title "Connect AI tools" (16px semibold) + close `chrome-icon-btn` sm (`close`). Esc / scrim click / Done close it; focus returns to the settings trigger.

**Top.** `chrome-code-field` (default, 36px, mono 12.5px) with `artisign setup` + copy button (`content_copy`; after click the icon switches to `check` for ~1.5s). Line below (12px secondary): "Run in a terminal — it connects every tool it finds."

**Client list.** Label "Or add it by hand, per tool" (11px tertiary). Bordered list (radius.sm), one 40px row per client, in this order: Claude Code (`terminal`), Claude Desktop (`desktop_windows`), Cursor (`ads_click`), Codex CLI (`terminal`), VS Code (`code`), opencode (`terminal`). Each row: 18px icon, name, `chrome-status-chip` right-aligned, 16px chevron column reserved on every row.
- Chips: **Connected** (ok tint + `check`), **Not connected** (outlined), **Not installed** (muted fill; name and icon also tertiary, row not expandable).
- Only **Not connected** rows expand (chevron `expand_more` collapsed / `expand_less` open); drawn open here: Claude Code and Cursor. Connected rows are not expandable (nothing to do).
- Expanded panel (indent 42px): hint line 11.5px secondary, then `chrome-code-field` `block` (mono 12px, wraps, copy button top right). Claude Code: "Run in a terminal:" + `claude mcp add artisign -- npx -y artisign@2.1.1 mcp`. Cursor: "Add this to `~/.cursor/mcp.json`:" + `{"mcpServers":{"artisign":{"command":"npx","args":["-y","artisign@2.1.1","mcp"]}}}`. The version is the running version (pinned `npx -y artisign@<version> mcp`). Codex CLI / VS Code / opencode / Claude Desktop use the equivalent entry for their config (paths per CHANGELOG 2.1.0), same layout.
- **Copy only — there are no Connect buttons**; setup is done by `artisign setup` in a terminal.

**Footer.** Left "3 of 6 connected" (11.5px tertiary), right primary button "Done" (the single primary of the view). Statuses are read when the dialog opens; no live polling.
